name: Ironforge main entrance
proofNotes: Interior endpoint is a native WMO floor anchor; root ADT terrain is overhead and does not define city-floor height.
The endpoint XY is already allowed in the largest original Ironforge terrain-mask component (13656 cells).
Two native bounded stair risers support the discontinuities between upward floor faces. Samples contain their floor endpoints; riser interiors are explicit step witnesses.
No character-radius sweep, embedded M2 collision, or ADT MDDF collision audit was performed.

nativeStairPolicy.note: Native short steep collidable risers may face either direction, including trunk_crossing groups. Supported by selected native triangles; not an arbitrary gap exemption.
